# netbox_users (Data Source)

Lists user objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_users" "test" {
  limit = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, username, username__empty, username__ic, username__ie, username__iew, username__iregex, username__isw, username__n, username__nic, username__nie, username__niew, username__nisw, username__regex. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) The matching users. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of is_active.
- `date_joined` (String) When the account was created.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `first_name` (String)
- `group_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the groups the user belongs to.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the user may log in.
- `last_login` (String) When the user last logged in; null until the first login.
- `last_name` (String)
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the user. Never returned by NetBox, so changes made outside Terraform go unnoticed.
- `url` (String)
- `username` (String)
